blocks.prompt: 4 (i) If \(x\) is so small that its square and higher powers can be neglected, then show that \(\frac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 - x}} \approx 1 - \frac{3}{2}x\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh approximation ka sawal hai: \(x\) itna chhota hai ke \(x^{2}\) ko chhor sakte hain, is liye har series ki sirf \(1 + nx\) leni hai.
Lekin pehle chhapa hua left side ghaur se dekhiye: \(\frac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 - x}}\) seedha \(\sqrt{1 - x}\) ke barabar hai, aur us ka jawab \(1 - \tfrac{3}{2}x\) nahi aa sakta.
Plan: pehle chhapa hua expression imaandari se hal karenge, phir dikhayenge ke diya gaya jawab \(\frac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 + x}}\) ka hai (neeche kitab ki ghalti wala note dekhiye).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 - x}}\), aur \(x^{2}\) va us se bari powers qabil-e-nazarandaz (neglect karne layak) hain.
Dikhana hai (jaisa chhapa hai): \(\approx 1 - \frac{3}{2}x\).
Tareeqa: \(x^{2}\) aur us se bari powers chhorni hain, is liye har bracket sirf \(1 + nx\) tak kholi jayegi, aur do \(x\) wali terms ka product (jo \(x^{2}\) banata hai) bhi chhor diya jayega.

Chhapa hua left side simplify karein
\[\dfrac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 - x}} = (1 - x)^{1 - \frac{1}{2}}\]
\[= (1 - x)^{1/2}\]
Kyun: Upar \((1 - x)^{1}\) aur neeche \((1 - x)^{1/2}\). Same base ki powers divide hon to powers minus hoti hain: \(1 - \tfrac{1}{2} = \tfrac{1}{2}\). Yani yeh sirf \(\sqrt{1 - x}\) hai.

\(x\) wali term tak kholein
\[(1 - x)^{1/2} \approx 1 + \dfrac{1}{2}(-x)\]
\[= 1 - \dfrac{1}{2}x\]
Kyun: \(1 + nx\) mein \(n = \tfrac{1}{2}\) aur \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) rakha.

Chhape hue jawab se muqabla
\[1 - \dfrac{1}{2}x \ne 1 - \dfrac{3}{2}x\]
Kyun: Dono barabar nahi, is liye chhapi hui baat saabit ho hi nahi sakti. Matlab denominator mein misprint hai. Agar neeche \(\sqrt{1 + x}\) ho to diya hua jawab bilkul sahi aata hai; ab wohi kar ke dekhte hain.
Dhyan dein: 'show that' wale sawal mein agar baar baar koshish ke bawajood jawab na mile to sawal ko simplify kar ke dekhiye; kabhi kabhi ghalti sawal mein hoti hai, aap ke kaam mein nahi.

Sahi expression ko product banayein
\[\dfrac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 + x}} = (1 - x)(1 + x)^{-1/2}\]
Kyun: Square root ka matlab power \(\tfrac{1}{2}\), aur neeche se upar laane par \(-\tfrac{1}{2}\).

\((1 + x)^{-1/2}\) kholein
\[(1 + x)^{-1/2} \approx 1 - \dfrac{1}{2}x\]
Kyun: \(1 + nx\) mein \(n = -\tfrac{1}{2}\). Baqi terms mein \(x^{2}\) ya us se bari powers hain, jo chhor deni hain.

Multiply karein aur \(x^{2}\) chhorein
\[(1 - x)\left(1 - \dfrac{1}{2}x\right)\]
\[= 1 - \dfrac{1}{2}x - x + \dfrac{1}{2}x^{2}\]
\[\approx 1 - \dfrac{3}{2}x\]
Kyun: Har term ko har term se multiply kiya. \(\tfrac{1}{2}x^{2}\) wali term chhor di kyunke \(x^{2}\) neglect karna hai. \(x\) wali terms: \(-\tfrac{1}{2}x - x = -\tfrac{3}{2}x\).

Tasdeeq
\[x = 0.01:\ \dfrac{0.99}{\sqrt{1.01}} = 0.985087\]
\[1 - 0.015 = 0.985\]
Kyun: Farq sirf 0.0001 ke qareeb hai, jo \(x^{2}\) ke size ka hai, yani wohi hissa jo humne chhora tha. Is liye approximation sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: Jaisa chhapa hai: \(\frac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 - x}} = \sqrt{1 - x} \approx 1 - \frac{1}{2}x\). Diya hua natija \(\frac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 + x}} \approx 1 - \frac{3}{2}x\) ke liye sahi hai. Saabit ho gaya (sahi denominator ke saath).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein left side \(\frac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 - x}}\) chhapa hai, jo asal mein \(\sqrt{1 - x} \approx 1 - \frac{1}{2}x\) hai; yeh \(1 - \frac{3}{2}x\) nahi ban sakta. Diya hua jawab \(\frac{1 - x}{\sqrt{1 + x}}\) ka hai, yani denominator mein \(1 + x\) hona chahiye tha. Humne wohi saabit kiya hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) If \(x\) is so small that its square and higher powers can be neglected, then show that \(\frac{\sqrt{1 + 2x}}{\sqrt{1 - x}} \approx 1 + \frac{3}{2}x\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi approximation ka sawal hai jahan \(x^{2}\) chhorna hai.
Left side ko \((1 + 2x)^{1/2}(1 - x)^{-1/2}\) likh kar har ek ki sirf \(1 + nx\) leni hai.
Dikhana kya hai? Ke yeh \(1 + \tfrac{3}{2}x\) ke barabar hai.
Plan: dono kholna, multiply, \(x^{2}\) wali term hatana, muqabla.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{\sqrt{1 + 2x}}{\sqrt{1 - x}}\), \(x^{2}\) va us se bari powers neglect.
Dikhana hai: \(\approx 1 + \frac{3}{2}x\).
Tareeqa: \(x^{2}\) aur us se bari powers chhorni hain, is liye har bracket sirf \(1 + nx\) tak kholi jayegi, aur do \(x\) wali terms ka product (jo \(x^{2}\) banata hai) bhi chhor diya jayega.

Product ki shakal
\[\dfrac{\sqrt{1 + 2x}}{\sqrt{1 - x}} = (1 + 2x)^{1/2}(1 - x)^{-1/2}\]
Kyun: Root ko power \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) likha, aur neeche wali bracket ko upar la kar power \(-\tfrac{1}{2}\) di. Ab do brackets ka seedha product hai.

Har bracket kholein
\[(1 + 2x)^{1/2} \approx 1 + \dfrac{1}{2}(2x) = 1 + x\]
\[(1 - x)^{-1/2} \approx 1 + \left(-\dfrac{1}{2}\right)(-x)\]
\[= 1 + \dfrac{1}{2}x\]
Kyun: \(1 + nx\) mein formula ke \(x\) ki jagah poori doosri term rakhi: pehli mein \(2x\), doosri mein \(-x\). Doosri mein minus mein minus plus ban gaya.
Dhyan dein: \((1 - x)^{-1/2}\) mein do minus hain (power ka aur \(x\) ka). Ek bhi bhool gaye to sign ulta ho jayega.

Multiply karein aur \(x^{2}\) chhorein
\[(1 + x)\left(1 + \dfrac{1}{2}x\right)\]
\[= 1 + \dfrac{1}{2}x + x + \dfrac{1}{2}x^{2}\]
\[\approx 1 + \dfrac{3}{2}x\]
Kyun: \(\tfrac{1}{2}x^{2}\) neglect kar di. \(x\) wali terms jama: \(x + \tfrac{1}{2}x = \tfrac{3}{2}x\). Yahi right side hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 0.01:\ \sqrt{\dfrac{1.02}{0.99}} = 1.015038\]
\[1 + 0.015 = 1.015\]
Kyun: Farq \(x^{2}\) jitna chhota hai, is liye natija sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (iii) If \(x\) is so small that its square and higher powers can be neglected, then show that \(\frac{(9 + 7x)^{1/2} - (16 + 3x)^{1/4}}{4 + 5x} \approx \frac{1}{4} - \frac{17}{284}x\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan teen brackets hain aur koi bhi 1 se shuru nahi hoti. Is liye pehle 9, 16 aur 4 bahar nikalne honge.
Phir har series ki sirf \(1 + nx\) leni hai, aur numerator ko \((4 + 5x)^{-1}\) se multiply karna hai.
Dikhana kya hai? \(\frac{1}{4} - \frac{17}{284}x\) (jaisa chhapa hai). Hum dekhenge ke sahi number 384 hai, 284 nahi.
Plan: numerator, denominator, product, muqabla.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{(9 + 7x)^{1/2} - (16 + 3x)^{1/4}}{4 + 5x}\), \(x^{2}\) va us se bari powers neglect.
Dikhana hai: \(\approx \frac{1}{4} - \frac{17}{284}x\) (jaisa chhapa hai).
Tareeqa: Har bracket se ek number bahar nikal kar usay 1 se shuru karenge. Phir \(x^{2}\) aur us se bari powers chhorni hain, is liye har bracket sirf \(1 + nx\) tak kholi jayegi, aur do \(x\) wali terms ka product (jo \(x^{2}\) banata hai) bhi chhor diya jayega.

Pehli bracket
\[(9 + 7x)^{1/2} = 3\left(1 + \dfrac{7x}{9}\right)^{1/2}\]
\[\approx 3\left(1 + \dfrac{7x}{18}\right) = 3 + \dfrac{7}{6}x\]
Kyun: 9 bahar nikala to \(9^{1/2} = 3\) bana. \(1 + nx\): \(\tfrac{1}{2} \cdot \tfrac{7x}{9} = \tfrac{7x}{18}\). Phir 3 se multiply: \(\tfrac{21}{18} = \tfrac{7}{6}\).

Doosri bracket
\[(16 + 3x)^{1/4} = 2\left(1 + \dfrac{3x}{16}\right)^{1/4}\]
\[\approx 2\left(1 + \dfrac{3x}{64}\right) = 2 + \dfrac{3}{32}x\]
Kyun: \(16^{1/4}\) ka matlab 16 ka fourth root, jo 2 hai (\(2^{4} = 16\)). \(\tfrac{1}{4} \cdot \tfrac{3x}{16} = \tfrac{3x}{64}\), aur 2 se multiply karne par \(\tfrac{6}{64} = \tfrac{3}{32}\).

Numerator
\[\left(3 + \dfrac{7}{6}x\right) - \left(2 + \dfrac{3}{32}x\right)\]
\[= 1 + \left(\dfrac{112}{96} - \dfrac{9}{96}\right)x\]
\[= 1 + \dfrac{103}{96}x\]
Kyun: Numbers numbers se: \(3 - 2 = 1\). \(x\) wali terms ke liye common denominator chahiye: 6 aur 32 ka LCM 96 hai, \(\tfrac{7}{6} = \tfrac{112}{96}\), \(\tfrac{3}{32} = \tfrac{9}{96}\).
Dhyan dein: doosri bracket ke aage minus hai, is liye us ki \(x\) wali term bhi minus ho kar aati hai.

Denominator
\[(4 + 5x)^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{4}\left(1 + \dfrac{5x}{4}\right)^{-1}\]
\[\approx \dfrac{1}{4}\left(1 - \dfrac{5}{4}x\right)\]
Kyun: Neeche wali bracket ko upar laya to power \(-1\) bani. 4 bahar nikala to \(4^{-1} = \tfrac{1}{4}\). \(1 + nx\) mein \(n = -1\): \(1 - \tfrac{5x}{4}\).

Multiply karein aur \(x^{2}\) chhorein
\[\dfrac{1}{4}\left(1 + \dfrac{103}{96}x\right)\left(1 - \dfrac{120}{96}x\right)\]
\[\approx \dfrac{1}{4}\left(1 - \dfrac{17}{96}x\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{4} - \dfrac{17}{384}x\]
Kyun: Dono brackets ki \(x\) wali terms ka product \(x^{2}\) deta hai, woh chhor diya. Baqi \(x\) wali terms jama: \(\tfrac{103}{96} - \tfrac{120}{96} = -\tfrac{17}{96}\). Phir \(\tfrac{1}{4}\) andar le gaye: \(4 \times 96 = 384\).

Tasdeeq
\[x = 0.01:\ \text{L.H.S.} = 0.2495573\]
\[\dfrac{1}{4} - \dfrac{17}{384}(0.01) = 0.2495573\]
Kyun: Saat decimal tak barabar. Agar 284 hota to jawab 0.2494014 aata, jo saaf door hai. Is se pakka hua ke sahi number 384 hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\frac{(9 + 7x)^{1/2} - (16 + 3x)^{1/4}}{4 + 5x} \approx \frac{1}{4} - \frac{17}{384}x\). Saabit ho gaya (kitab mein 384 ki jagah 284 chhapa hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein right side \(\frac{1}{4} - \frac{17}{284}x\) chhapa hai. Sahi \(\frac{1}{4} - \frac{17}{384}x\) hai, kyunke \(\frac{1}{4} \times \frac{17}{96} = \frac{17}{384}\). Yeh sirf chhapai ki ghalti hai (3 ki jagah 2).

blocks.prompt: 4 (iv) If \(x\) is so small that its square and higher powers can be neglected, then show that \(\frac{\sqrt{4 + x}}{(1 - x)^{3}} \approx 2 + \frac{25}{4}x\)
blocks.explanation:
Phir wohi approximation: \(x^{2}\) chhorna hai. Expression \((4 + x)^{1/2}(1 - x)^{-3}\) hai.
Pehli bracket 4 se shuru hoti hai, is liye 4 bahar nikalna hoga; doosri pehle hi \(1 - x\) hai.
Dikhana kya hai? \(2 + \tfrac{25}{4}x\).
Plan: dono kholna, multiply, \(x^{2}\) hatana.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{\sqrt{4 + x}}{(1 - x)^{3}}\), \(x^{2}\) va us se bari powers neglect.
Dikhana hai: \(\approx 2 + \frac{25}{4}x\).
Tareeqa: \(x^{2}\) aur us se bari powers chhorni hain, is liye har bracket sirf \(1 + nx\) tak kholi jayegi, aur do \(x\) wali terms ka product (jo \(x^{2}\) banata hai) bhi chhor diya jayega.

Product ki shakal
\[\dfrac{\sqrt{4 + x}}{(1 - x)^{3}} = (4 + x)^{1/2}(1 - x)^{-3}\]
Kyun: Root ko power \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) banaya aur neeche wali bracket upar la kar power \(-3\) di.

Har bracket kholein
\[(4 + x)^{1/2} = 2\left(1 + \dfrac{x}{4}\right)^{1/2} \approx 2\left(1 + \dfrac{x}{8}\right)\]
\[(1 - x)^{-3} \approx 1 + (-3)(-x) = 1 + 3x\]
Kyun: 4 bahar nikala to \(\sqrt{4} = 2\) aur andar \(\tfrac{x}{4}\); \(\tfrac{1}{2} \cdot \tfrac{x}{4} = \tfrac{x}{8}\). Doosri mein \(n = -3\) aur \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\): minus mein minus plus, to \(1 + 3x\).
Dhyan dein: \((1 - x)^{-3}\) ko \(1 - 3x\) likhna aam ghalti hai. Power bhi negative hai aur term bhi, dono milkar plus dete hain.

Multiply karein aur \(x^{2}\) chhorein
\[2\left(1 + \dfrac{x}{8}\right)(1 + 3x)\]
\[\approx 2\left(1 + \dfrac{x}{8} + 3x\right)\]
\[= 2\left(1 + \dfrac{25}{8}x\right) = 2 + \dfrac{25}{4}x\]
Kyun: \(\tfrac{x}{8} \cdot 3x\) mein \(x^{2}\) hai, chhor diya. \(\tfrac{1}{8} + 3 = \tfrac{1}{8} + \tfrac{24}{8} = \tfrac{25}{8}\), phir 2 se multiply karne par \(\tfrac{25}{4}\).

Tasdeeq
\[x = 0.01:\ \dfrac{\sqrt{4.01}}{0.99^{3}} = 2.063795\]
\[2 + 0.0625 = 2.0625\]
Kyun: Farq takreeban 0.0013 hai. Yeh chhori hui \(x^{2}\) terms ka asar hai, jin ka coefficient yahan kaafi bara (takreeban 12.7) hai. \(x\) jitna chhota hoga, farq utna kam hoga.
